mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 61 degrees. The moon is in its First Quarter phase. Tonight will be cool with an overnight low of 42 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Verona Police Department has reported the arrest of a school bus driver on Thursday, October 15, for operating while impaired. While no injuries occurred, authorities are currently investigating potential damage to a traffic sign outside of city limits.

It is a busy time in Verona. We have live music occurring today at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can attend yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, next week features trivia nights at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac's, and The Bogey Factory, alongside music and art events.

During the incident on Thursday, October 15, officers located a school bus near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace. They developed probable cause to believe the driver was operating the vehicle while impaired, leading to an arrest for O W I.
Stop by for some delicious Mint Cookie, the flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:00 PM tonight.
